# Diffdump

> Diffdump is a no-account web service for turning unified Git diffs into focused, unlisted review links and for viewing GitHub pull requests, commits, and comparisons.

Canonical origin: https://diffdump.com

Diffdump renders multi-file patches with syntax highlighting, unified and split layouts, line wrapping, a searchable file tree, file categories, and light and dark themes.

To create a share programmatically, send a `PUT` request to `https://diffdump.com/d` with a raw UTF-8 unified diff as the request body. A successful request returns `201 Created` with the unlisted review URL as `text/plain`. Empty or invalid diffs return `400`, diffs larger than 2 MiB return `413`, and storage failures return `500`.

Example:

```sh
git diff | curl -T- https://diffdump.com/d
```

Shared diffs use random 96-bit URL slugs, are stored in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket, expire after 24 hours, and are marked `noindex, nofollow`. Share URLs are unlisted rather than access-controlled; anyone possessing a URL can open it. There is no public listing.

Public GitHub pull requests, commits, and comparisons can be opened without creating or storing a Diffdump share. Replace `github.com` with `diffdump.com` in a supported GitHub URL, or use the GitHub form on the home page.

Private GitHub repositories can be viewed with an optional classic personal access token carrying `repo` scope. The token stays in browser local storage and is sent directly to `api.github.com`; neither the token nor the fetched private diff is submitted to or stored by Diffdump.

## Primary resources

- [Diffdump](https://diffdump.com/): Create an unlisted diff share or open a GitHub diff.
- [GitHub diff form](https://diffdump.com/github): Open a public or private GitHub pull request, commit, or comparison.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/hsubra89/diffdump): Source code, complete capabilities, architecture, local development, and deployment instructions.

## Optional

- [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/): Format used by this file.
